en.SUPER + ALT + U: devolver todo a Linux: SUPER + ALT + U: return everything to Linux
en.No se pudo leer el estado del plugin: Could not read the plugin status
en.Instala Windows desde el menú de Omarchy: Install Windows from the Omarchy menu to use this feature.
en.Enciende un dispositivo y pasa a Windows: Turn a device on to move it to Windows; turn it off to return it to Linux. Return all: SUPER + ALT + U.
en.Cierra y abre Windows una vez para poder: Close and reopen Windows once to enable device transfers.
en.No pases el teclado o ratón que usas, ni: Do not transfer the keyboard or mouse you are using, or Bluetooth.
en.Cierra la ventana de Windows y ábrelo en: Close the Windows window and open its own display.
en.Abre Windows en su propia pantalla, dond: Open Windows on its own display to see the transferred mouse's cursor.
en.No hay discos montados en /mnt, /media o: No disks are mounted in /mnt, /media or /run/media.
en.Si cambias letras o discos, vuelve a abr: If you change letters or disks, reopen "Activar discos" in Windows.
en.Para que salgan con su letra, abre una v: To assign drive letters, open this once in Windows: Desktop › Shared › Omarchy Tool › Discos › Activar discos.
en.Deja que el navegador configure estos di: Allow websites such as CORSAIR Web Hub to configure these devices. Only your session gets access. Changes require your password; then reload the website and connect the device.
en.No hay dispositivos USB de este tipo con: No USB devices of this type are connected.
en.no se pudo cambiar la configuración de W: could not update the Windows configuration
en.no se pudo devolver el dispositivo a Lin: could not return the device to Linux
en.no se pudo pasar el dispositivo a Window: could not transfer the device to Windows
en.no se pudo devolver los dispositivos a L: could not return the devices to Linux
en.solo se pueden compartir carpetas de /mn: only folders under /mnt, /media, /run/media or /home can be shared: %1
en.la ruta pasa por un enlace; usa la ruta: the path uses a symlink; use the real path: %1
en.letra no válida: %1 (de D a Y; Z es la d: invalid letter: %1 (D to Y; Z belongs to Omarchy)
en.la letra %1: ya la usa otro disco: drive letter %1: is already used by another disk
en.no se encontró el control de la VM: could not find the VM monitor
en.no se pudo hablar con la VM: could not communicate with the VM
en.Windows no tomó %1 (¿está conectado?): Windows did not attach %1 (is it connected?)
en.Para devolverlo a Linux: SUPER + ALT + U: To return it to Linux: SUPER + ALT + U, or in Windows open Shared › Omarchy Tool › Periféricos › Devolver periféricos a Linux.
en.%1 dispositivo(s) de vuelta; su interrup: %1 device(s) returned; their switches are now off.
en.Tarda un poco. Se abrirá la pantalla de: This may take a moment. The Windows display will open and selected peripherals will transfer automatically.
en.Marca hasta 2 discos. En Windows salen e: Select up to 2 disks. They appear under \\host.lan in Windows, next to Shared. Changes require your password and take effect when Windows reopens.
